mapper.select: SELECT last_viewed_at FROM sys_module_read WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND module = #{module} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_module_read (user_id, module, last_viewed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{module}, #{lastViewedAt}) -- 只增不减：多实例时钟偏移时较旧的实例写入会回退游标使旧数据重新计入，故仅当新时间更晚时覆盖 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_viewed_at = IF(last_viewed_at IS NULL OR last_viewed_at < #{lastViewedAt}, #{lastViewedAt}, last_viewed_at)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM appeal_parent WHERE create_time > #{after}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM appeal_child WHERE create_time > #{after}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM admin_work_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND is_archived = 0 AND create_time > #{after}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM admin_work_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING_DISPATCH'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM street_work_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND street_receive_time > #{after} AND street_office = #{streetOffice}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM warning_record WHERE trigger_time > #{after}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM warning_record WHERE status = 'SENT' AND dept_sent_time > #{after} AND (FIND_IN_SET(#{category}, department) > 0 OR FIND_IN_SET(CONCAT(#{countyCode}, ':', #{category}), department) > 0)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM warning_street_dispatch d JOIN warning_record w ON w.id = d.warning_id WHERE w.status = 'SENT' AND d.dispatch_time > #{after} AND d.street_office = #{streetOffice}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sensitive_event WHERE trigger_time > #{after}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM admin_audit_log WHERE create_time > #{after}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dept_audit_log WHERE create_time > #{after}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM street_audit_log WHERE create_time > #{after}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM street_audit_log WHERE create_time > #{after} AND ( (operator = #{operator} AND NOT (module = 'order-receive')) OR (module = 'order-receive' AND target_type = #{targetType}) )
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_account_audit WHERE COALESCE(apply_time, create_time) > #{after}
